nodes.question: How can winegrowers in Czechia contribute to sustainable viticulture practices?
nodes.answer: Winegrowers in Czechia can contribute to sustainable viticulture practices by retaining water in the soil, planting trees near vineyards to maintain water levels, and taking advantage of European Union opportunities to expand vineyards by up to one percent annually.
